minutes.headline: Commission approved a ~$2,620 cemetery software invoice and began planning North and South Cemetery lot expansions
minutes.summary: The Cemetery Commission approved the annual RainMaker/SIMS cemetery-management software invoice and discussed how few burial lots remain sellable in the North and South Cemeteries, prompting early planning for a North Cemetery back-lot expansion (already funded at town meeting) and a possible South Cemetery expansion. Members also discussed hedge/tree replacement, stone wall repairs, mowing for the holidays, pursuing grants and earmarks, and reviewed cemetery fund balances, but made no spending decisions on those items beyond the software invoice.

budget_items.what_was_said: The invoice covers annual maintenance for one full-access license (for DPW) and one read-only license for the SIMS cemetery database.
A separate annual hosting fee covers the public-facing burial search website tied to the same database.
The commission voted to approve expending funds to pay the combined RainMaker invoice; the treasurer's office will process payment after signatures.

decisions.decision: Commission will schedule a future meeting for RainMaker to train the three commissioners on the SIMS software via Zoom.
Chair to follow up with DPW's Bill Bernard on North Cemetery back-lot expansion plans, with the understanding the commission will be kept informed before any work begins.
Chair will contact Bill regarding survey work and tree removal for the North Cemetery expansion, and check with the assessor's office about existing GIS/survey maps.
Chair will ask Bill about locating local stump grinders to remove hedge stumps before replanting trees.
Donna Landry will look into pricing for stone wall repair around the cemeteries.
Commission is already scheduled to walk the South Cemetery back-lot area in August.
Commission will contact Town Manager Jennifer about the process for pursuing grants before deciding whether to seek an outside grant writer.
A member will look into how a prior earmark request was submitted (via the state representative/senator's office) to pursue funding again.
Commission will wait until July to finalize and notice the August meeting date, to be held at the cemeteries.
Commission will meet at the North Cemetery parking lot and walk that cemetery, with South Cemetery to be walked on a separate date.

what_happened.line: Commission approved the annual RainMaker/SIMS cemetery software invoice, the amount as heard from captions.
Members began planning a North Cemetery back-lot expansion, already funded at town meeting, and a possible South Cemetery expansion.
No new spending was voted beyond the software invoice; hedge and tree replacement, stone walls, and grant funding were discussed without decisions.
The commission reviewed cemetery fund balances and will discuss a spending plan for sale-of-lots revenue at a future meeting.

why_it_matters: Cemetery lot supply is running low, which is why an expansion already funded at town meeting is being planned for the North Cemetery, with a South Cemetery expansion also under discussion.
How the sale-of-lots, capital, and perpetual care fund balances get spent was reviewed but not decided, a question that affects future cemetery costs to the town.
No new town spending was authorized beyond the recurring software fee.
